P.name: Pit Grit
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Heart of the Half-Beast:}} '''Sett''' {{as|{{sti|health regeneration|regenerates}}}}{{ft|an additional {{as|{{pp|0.075;0.25;0.5;1;1.025;1.05|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|changedisplay=true|round=3}} health}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds per {{sti|{{as|5% of his '''missing''' health}}}}.|up-to an additional {{as|{{pp|0.075*19;0.25*19;0.5*19;1*19;1.025*19;1.05*19|1 to 16 for 4;19;20|changedisplay=true|round=3}} health}} per {{fd|0.5}} seconds, with the maximum reached at the threshold of {{sti|{{as|95% '''missing''' health}}}}.}}
P.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Heavy Hands:}} '''Sett's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} alternate between his {{as|Left Punch|armor}} and a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} {{tip|on-attack}}. '''Sett''' begins attacking with his {{as|Left Punch|armor}}, and will reset back to it after 2 seconds of not performing a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.
P.description3: '''Sett's''' {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}} is empowered to gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} (unless ''{{ai|Knuckle Down|Sett}}'' is active), attack at 8 times the {{as|Left Punch's|armor}} {{as|attack speed}}, and deal {{as|{{pp|5 + (90-5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}|physical damage}} {{as|(+ 55% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.

Q.name: Knuckle Down
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 3}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*2 to 50*2}} {{as|(+ 2% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2 to 3*2}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: For {{fd|1.5}} seconds, '''Sett''' also gains {{sti|movement speed|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
Q.description3: ''Knuckle Down {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sett's''' basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a {{as|Left Punch|Armor}} followed by a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}, resetting '''Sett's''' current {{ai|Pit Grit|Sett}} state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.''

Q.name: Looking for a Fight
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' empowers his next two basic attacks within 5 seconds to gain {{sti|50 '''bonus''' range}} and deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 400 '''total''' damage of each attack against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10 to 50}} {{as|(+ 1% {{as|(+ {{ap|1 to 3}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}|Total Bonus Physical Damage|{{ap|10*2 to 50*2}} {{as|(+ 2% {{as|(+ {{ap|1*2 to 3*2}}% per 100 AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health)}}}}
Q.description2: For {{fd|1.5}} seconds, '''Sett''' also gains {{sti|movement speed|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} while facing {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} within 2000 units.
Q.description3: ''Knuckle Down {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Sett's''' basic attack timer. The empowered attacks are guaranteed to be a {{as|Left Punch|Armor}} followed by a {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}, resetting '''Sett's''' current {{ai|Pit Grit|Sett}} state (if applicable) and ignoring the usual time-out period for a follow-up {{as|Right Punch|buzzword3}}.''

W.name: Haymaker
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Sett''' stores 100% of {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after resistances and modifiers.}} taken as ''Grit'' on his resource bar, up to a cap of {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}}. Each instance of stored ''Grit'' decays in value by 30% every second after 4 seconds.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' charges up a strike over the cast time. Additionally, he immediately consumes all of his stored ''Grit'' to grant himself a {{tip|shield}} at the start of the cast time that is equal to the expended ''Grit'' for 3 seconds, decaying in strength over the duration after {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
W.description3: After the cast time, he unleashes a massive blast in an area in the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit; those hit in a line in the middle are dealt {{ccs|{{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}|true}} instead.

E.name: Facebreaker
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' {{tip|airborne|pulls in}} enemies at his front and back along the target direction, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 70% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. ''Facebreaker'' deals {{as|{{pp|125 to 250}} '''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monsters}}.
E.description2: If ''Facebreaker'' affects at least one enemy on each side, all enemies are {{tip|stun|stunned}} for 1 second upon landing.
E.description3: '''''Sett''' becomes {{tip|lockout|unable}} to move or attack for {{fd|0.25}} seconds after Facebreaker's cast time.''

R.name: The Show Stopper
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Sett''' {{tip|suppression|suppresses}} and {{tip|true sight|reveals}} the target enemy {{tip|champion}} while {{tip|dash|dashing}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} to their location and {{tip|attach|attaching}} them to himself upon arrival. He leaps another 600 units in the same direction to slam the target into the ground, creating a massive shockwave and quickly {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward 250 units beyond the impact.
R.description2: Enemies within {{tt|the epicenter|125 unit radius around the target's landing location, but not the true center of the area of effect}} take {{ccs|{{as|physical damage}}|physical}}, and other enemies hit by the shockwave take {{as|physical damage}} that is reduced by up to 75% based on proximity. All targets hit are {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 99% for 1 second.
R.leveling2: {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|200 to 400}} {{as|(+ 120% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40 to 60}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|200*0.25 to 400*0.25}} {{as|(+ 30% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|40*0.25 to 60*0.25}}% of primary target's '''bonus''' health)}}}}
R.description3: ''The leap will end and create the impact prematurely upon encountering terrain that cannot be dashed through, whether by distance or invalid space.''
